findings.evidence: OSS customer status screen has NO aria-live / role=status region on its dynamic status columns. DOM grep: `aria-live="..."` count = 0 across 10-oss-customer-ready-notification.dom.html; the two columns use only role="region" aria-label="En préparation" and role="region" aria-label="Prêt". When an order moves to ready (our A0024 appears in the Prêt region with class oss-new-ready oss-pulse-ready) a screen-reader user gets no announcement. Per protocol category #8 this is P2 (live region missing on dynamic-status container); P1 escalation requires it to block a primary task path — OSS is a passive customer wall display, not an interactive flow, so it stays P2. (KDS recall path DOES carry aria-live=polite per card markup, so the chef-side critical path is covered.)
findings.fix_hint: resources/js/components/frontend/order-status-screen/* (OSS column wrapper): add aria-live="polite" + role="status" to the 'Prêt'/ready <ul> so newly-ready order numbers are announced. Non-blocking; customer wall display.

findings.evidence: Kiosk private-channel realtime is degraded on the public terminal: 05-kiosk network.json shows POST localhost:8000/api/broadcasting/auth → 302 then GET localhost:8000/api/login → 401, and console.json carries level=error 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized)' on /api/login. This is the DOCUMENTED KNOWN SIGNAL (AUDIT_PLAN lines 107-114): the kiosk SPA's global Echo bootstrap attempts private-channel auth with a session guard the public terminal doesn't hold. CONSEQUENCE OBSERVED + ACCOUNTED: a live 86 on an already-mounted kiosk does NOT re-apply without a reload; the spec therefore proved the cascade via a FRESH kiosk load — backend /api/frontend/menu returns is_available=false and the freshly-loaded card 26 renders class kiosk-product-card--filtered-out + aria-disabled=true + add button disabled + title="Épuisé" (localized, NOT a raw key — 0 occurrences of 'out_of_stock_manual' in the kiosk DOM, contradicting the spec's stale narration comment). The kiosk CORE ordering flow (idle→catalogue→card-render→disabled-protection: clicking the 86'd card did NOT open the wizard) works WITHOUT the realtime channel → realtime-degraded, at-most-P2 per plan, NOT a P0 silent_error.
findings.fix_hint: No product fix required for V1 (documented degraded-realtime + reload fallback, owner-accepted). Cloud-prep backlog: expose a kiosk-scoped public broadcasting auth (or use the kiosk-event poll path the kiosk already falls back to) so live availability flips reflect on a mounted terminal without reload. Suppress the 401 to console.warn so it stops registering as a console error.
